entries.stepText: Fashion or mark a simple token to hold the spell.
entries.skillCheck: Manufacturing Expertise Wood or Manufacturing Expertise Metal or Manufacturing Expertise Soft or Manufacturing Expertise Paper or Art Expertise Painting
entries.requiredItem: A suitable scrap of cloth, wood, wax, or paper
entries.failureConsequence: The token is too crude to hold the working securely.
entries.stepNotes: A common support step for household or charm magic.
entries.tooltip: Fashion or mark a simple token to hold the spell. (trivial)

entries.stepText: Speak, sing, or recite the working in a fixed measured form.
entries.skillCheck: Charisma Perform or Art Expertise Music
entries.failureConsequence: The form breaks and the step must be begun again.
entries.stepNotes: Useful for prayers, charms, and sung folk formulas.
entries.tooltip: Speak, sing, or recite the working in a fixed measured form. (trivial)

entries.stepText: Wash hands, face, tools, or threshold before proceeding.
entries.skillCheck: Faith Ascetic or Learning Expertise Religion
entries.requiredItem: Clean water, smoke, or ash
entries.failureConsequence: The step leaves the working spiritually untidy.
entries.stepNotes: Light purification, common in religion and wards.
entries.tooltip: Wash hands, face, tools, or threshold before proceeding. (trivial)

entries.stepText: Copy a short word, sign, or mark connected to the working.
entries.skillCheck: Art Expertise Writing or Art Expertise Painting
entries.requiredItem: Wax tablet, scrap, ink, soot, or chalk
entries.failureConsequence: The copied sign is malformed and gives no support.
entries.stepNotes: A light scripted support step.
entries.tooltip: Copy a short word, sign, or mark connected to the working. (trivial)

entries.stepText: Fix the question or subject through a token, bowl, flame, or trace.
entries.skillCheck: Pagan Expertise Divination or Intelligence Investigation
entries.requiredItem: A token of the subject or a simple omen focus
entries.failureConsequence: The omen turns vague or points nowhere useful.
entries.stepNotes: A light support step for readings and searches.
entries.tooltip: Fix the question or subject through a token, bowl, flame, or trace. (trivial)

entries.stepText: Knot a length of red thread to carry the working.

entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Knot a length of red thread to carry the working.

entries.stepText: Shape a small figure in wax to carry the working.

entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Shape a small figure in wax to carry the working.

entries.stepText: Bind a sprig of dried herbs as the working's focus.

entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Bind a sprig of dried herbs as the working's focus.

entries.requiredItem: The caster's blood, spittle, or sweat
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.

entries.failureConsequence: Performed elsewhere, the place lends no power.

entries.stepText: Prepare a vessel, wax form, knot-string, or inscribed medium to exacting standards.
entries.skillCheck: Manufacturing Expertise Glass or Manufacturing Expertise Metal or Manufacturing Expertise Stone or Manufacturing Expertise Jewelry or Pagan Expertise Amulet or Learning Expertise Alchemy
entries.requiredItem: A vessel or medium suitable to the spell
entries.failureConsequence: The receptacle cracks, warps, or fails to hold the force cleanly.
entries.stepNotes: A medium-complexity crafted support step.
entries.tooltip: Prepare a vessel, wax form, knot-string, or inscribed medium to exacting standards. (easy)

entries.stepText: Maintain a sustained recitation, song, or patterned movement through the whole middle of the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Charisma Perform or Art Expertise Dance or Art Expertise Music
entries.failureConsequence: The rhythm breaks and weakens the assembled working.
entries.stepNotes: A longer performative phase rather than a quick charm.
entries.tooltip: Maintain a sustained recitation, song, or patterned movement through the whole middle of the rite. (easy)

entries.stepText: Observe a short fast, silence, or avoidance before the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Faith Ascetic
entries.timingConstraint: From sunrise to casting, or from the previous night as directed
entries.contactRestriction: No food, no speech, or no bed depending on the observance
entries.failureConsequence: The caster begins spiritually compromised.
entries.stepNotes: Typical for church and grave magic.
entries.tooltip: Observe a short fast, silence, or avoidance before the rite. (easy)

entries.stepText: Copy or compose a fuller seal, prayer block, or binding text.
entries.skillCheck: Art Expertise Writing or Art Expertise Painting or Learning Expertise Occult
entries.requiredItem: Prepared paper, parchment, board, or wax surface
entries.failureConsequence: The text bears hidden errors that may alter later steps.
entries.stepNotes: A medium script step for learned magic.
entries.tooltip: Copy or compose a fuller seal, prayer block, or binding text. (easy)

entries.stepText: Walk, mark, or measure the boundary to be worked in full.
entries.skillCheck: Outdoor Navigation or Pagan Expertise Warding
entries.requiredItem: Salt, chalk, ash, cord, or marker suited to the ward
entries.failureConsequence: A weak side remains open or mismeasured.
entries.stepNotes: A stronger version of simple placement.
entries.tooltip: Walk, mark, or measure the boundary to be worked in full. (easy)

entries.stepText: Prepare a fumigation, wash, draught, or herb bundle for the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Pagan Expertise Potion or Pagan Expertise Herbalism or Learning Expertise Apothecary
entries.requiredItem: Appropriate herbs, resins, or simples
entries.failureConsequence: The mixture weakens, fouls, or works against the desired tone.
entries.stepNotes: Useful across warding, divination, and grave workings.
entries.tooltip: Prepare a fumigation, wash, draught, or herb bundle for the rite. (easy)

entries.stepText: Endure a brief backlash, pressure, or answering sign while holding the rite together.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Occult or Faith Ascetic
entries.failureConsequence: The working slips and invites a stronger answer from what resists it.
entries.stepNotes: A medium danger step for more forceful rituals.
entries.tooltip: Endure a brief backlash, pressure, or answering sign while holding the rite together. (easy)

entries.requiredItem: A lock of the subject's hair
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Take a lock of the subject's hair as a sympathetic link.

entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Take a drop of the subject's blood as a sympathetic link.

entries.requiredItem: The subject's spittle, caught on cloth
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Obtain the subject's spittle as a sympathetic link.

entries.requiredItem: A worn, unwashed garment of the subject
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Obtain an unwashed garment the subject has worn.

entries.requiredItem: The subject's signature in writing
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Obtain the subject's signature as a sympathetic link.

entries.requiredItem: Earth from the subject's footprint
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Lift earth from the subject's fresh footprint.

entries.requiredItem: A tooth of the subject
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Obtain a tooth of the subject.

entries.stepText: Obtain a trinket the subject carries — a ring, comb, or charm.
entries.requiredItem: A ring, comb, or charm the subject carries
entries.failureConsequence: The component is unsuitable and must be obtained again.
entries.tooltip: Obtain a trinket the subject carries — a ring, comb, or charm.

entries.stepText: Acquire, verify, and speak a true name or equivalent binding identity during the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Occult
entries.requiredItem: A true name, verified sigil, bloodline designation, or exact identity token
entries.failureConsequence: A false or partial name may miscall, offend, or empower the wrong being.
entries.stepNotes: A classic hard grimoire requirement.
entries.tooltip: Acquire, verify, and speak a true name or equivalent binding identity during the rite. (average)

entries.stepText: Construct a full diagram, seal, circle, or layered warding geometry.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Occult or Pagan Expertise Warding
entries.requiredItem: Chalk, salt, ash, blood, metal filings, or equivalent marking medium
entries.failureConsequence: A flaw in the geometry creates a breach in the protection.
entries.stepNotes: More exacting than ordinary boundary work.
entries.tooltip: Construct a full diagram, seal, circle, or layered warding geometry. (average)

entries.stepText: Perform a difficult operation of separation, conjunction, distillation, or fixation as part of the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Alchemy
entries.requiredItem: Prepared apparatus, vessel, and alchemical matter suited to the operation
entries.failureConsequence: The material spoils, burns, or turns spiritually unclean.
entries.stepNotes: Hard alchemical support or transformation step.
entries.tooltip: Perform a difficult operation of separation, conjunction, distillation, or fixation as part of the rite. (average)

entries.stepText: Keep a full vigil, prayer-watch, or wake through the night before completion.
entries.skillCheck: Faith Ascetic or Learning Expertise Religion
entries.requiredItem: Lamp, candle, prayer text, or vigil station
entries.contactRestriction: No sleep, and no interruption once begun
entries.failureConsequence: Exhaustion and broken observance weaken every later step.
entries.stepNotes: A classic hard devotional burden.
entries.tooltip: Keep a full vigil, prayer-watch, or wake through the night before completion. (average)

entries.stepText: Maintain a demanding public or ceremonial performance under pressure.
entries.skillCheck: Charisma Perform or Art Expertise Dance or Art Expertise Music
entries.failureConsequence: The rite loses authority, coherence, or witness confidence at a critical moment.
entries.stepNotes: For invocation, conjuration, or public miracle-style workings.
entries.tooltip: Maintain a demanding public or ceremonial performance under pressure. (average)

entries.stepText: Secure a rare, dangerous, or costly component that cannot be replaced casually.
entries.skillCheck: Subterfuge Expertise Procuring or Intelligence Investigation
entries.requiredItem: A relic, saintly fragment, grave object, true relic, rare metal, or similarly dangerous component
entries.failureConsequence: The attempt exposes the rite's intent or leaves the spell impossible to finish for now.
entries.stepNotes: A high-cost acquisition step.
entries.tooltip: Secure a rare, dangerous, or costly component that cannot be replaced casually. (average)

entries.stepText: Handle the dead directly: open, lift, position, uncover, or work through the remains.
entries.skillCheck: Pagan Expertise Necromancy or Learning Expertise Medicine
entries.requiredItem: Corpse, bones, skull, grave opening, or remains in workable condition
entries.failureConsequence: The dead is angered, polluted, or becomes useless for the intended question or binding.
entries.stepNotes: A hard grave-side task.
entries.tooltip: Handle the dead directly: open, lift, position, uncover, or work through the remains. (average)

entries.stepText: Avoid all human contact for an extended period before the final act.
entries.timingConstraint: At least a full day and night unless a recipe says otherwise
entries.contactRestriction: No touch, speech, or shared food with another person
entries.failureConsequence: Breaking the isolation voids the step and may taint the whole rite.
entries.stepNotes: Pure requirement, no check.
entries.tooltip: Avoid all human contact for an extended period before the final act.

entries.stepText: Coordinate multiple helpers in fixed positions or duties during the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Charisma Perform or Learning Expertise Religion
entries.requiredItem: Two or more instructed helpers or witnesses
entries.failureConsequence: Confusion among the helpers breaks the shape of the rite.
entries.stepNotes: For group rites, exorcisms, large wards, and conjurations.
entries.tooltip: Coordinate multiple helpers in fixed positions or duties during the rite. (average)

entries.stepText: Hold the rite while a hostile pressure, spirit, or consequence pushes back.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Occult or Faith Ascetic or Strength Athletics
entries.failureConsequence: The caster or circle collapses under pressure and the ritual turns dangerous immediately.
entries.stepNotes: A hard resistance phase.
entries.tooltip: Hold the rite while a hostile pressure, spirit, or consequence pushes back. (average)

entries.stepText: Take on a spoken vow, burden, or self-binding that lasts beyond the rite.
entries.skillCheck: Learning Expertise Occult or Learning Expertise Religion
entries.requiredItem: A named vow, witness, token, or sign of the burden taken
entries.failureConsequence: The burden binds wrongly, too strongly, or to the wrong term.
entries.stepNotes: A major escalatory step suited to hard spells.
entries.tooltip: Take on a spoken vow, burden, or self-binding that lasts beyond the rite. (average)
